name: Thrive Leads
couldBuild: Opt-in forms in the usual placements — popup, ribbon, inline, slide-in — with display rules and a local subscriber table.
stillMissing: The integration list is the product: two dozen email services, each with its own API, list and tag semantics, and its own breaking changes. Add real A/B testing with statistics you can trust, and a template library nobody wants to design from scratch.
requirements: Multiple form types with per-post-type and per-URL display rules
Trigger rules: scroll depth, exit intent, time on page, click
A/B testing with a defined winner rule, not just two variants
Integrations with the email service you actually use, including tags
Conversion reporting per form and per placement
